Classic lane-bully vs hyperscaler: Syndra owns the lane pre-6, Kassadin threatens once Riftwalk and stacks are online; text reflects this.
Syndra spikes at 2, 6, Luden's; Kassadin spikes at 6 (Riftwalk) and level 16 (2s R). Covered in spikes[] and phases.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart said Skill x5 then Kassadin on First item and 2+ items while content win[], packet levelChart and the content whys say Syndra on all 7; cooldowns field had no digits; Null Sphere's magic shield and Nether Blade's auto-reset tell were unmentioned; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Content layer argues each row for Syndra (stun catches the telegraphed blink, burst kills before stacks ramp) and packet agrees; the full sides are the outlier. Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s so tracking its cooldown alone is not enough late — the mana-stacking cost is the real limiter. Q Null Sphere grants a magic-damage shield (absorbs Syndra's burst — force it first); W Nether Blade is an auto-attack reset, the tell his combo has started. The missing-interaction claiming Syndra E cancels Null Sphere as a channel is a flag misfire: Riot's text says Q interrupts OTHER channels, it is not itself channeled — not written.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to Syndra alone (win[] already agrees), cooldown numbers added, shield and auto-reset interactions folded into the Do's/Don'ts bullets.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Null Sphere shields him against magic damage — poke it out with Q first, then commit the QE-R once the shield is already spent.
